sections.executive_summary: The quant stack shows positive archived signal edge at the 7-day horizon (buy tier +2.19% excess, run_count 10), but forward paper books remain underperforming versus ^FTSE after costs: primary ai_judgment at −17.68% excess, verdict “underperforming.” ai_judgment does beat the rules control (−26.84% excess) and momentum_grace is the best relative paper track (−1.78% excess, 2.91% cost drag), so learning-track differentiation is working even though absolute returns are negative. The recent min_conviction raise to 0.45 (applied 2026-08-21) targets 21.2% cost drag but has zero epoch marks yet, so it is too early to judge improvement. Adaptive model-weight state is absent (model_weights null). The single biggest gap this week is the disconnect between positive archived/backtest signal excess and paper execution losses driven by cost drag and churn—primary and control tracks show 21–29% cost drag versus sub-3% on momentum_grace.
sections.performance_diagnosis:
- Primary (ai_judgment) excess after costs: −17.68% vs ^FTSE (benchmark_return +1.02%); total_return −16.66%; portfolio_value £833.43 on £1,000 contributed.
- Control (rules) excess after costs: −26.84% (benchmark_return +2.12%); total_return −24.72%; portfolio_value £752.85.
- Experimental (momentum_grace) excess after costs: −1.78% (benchmark_return −1.13%); total_return −2.91%; portfolio_value £970.87 — shallowest drawdown and lowest cost drag (2.91%) of the three named tracks.
- ai_judgment beats control (+9.16 pp excess) but neither primary nor control beats the market (beat_market: false).
- Cost drag: ai_judgment 21.25% (£212.48, 29 lifetime trades); rules 29.0% (£289.72, 48 trades); momentum_grace 2.91% (£29.15, 5 trades). Churn_health alerts flag elevated cost drag on both primary and control.
- Trade churn (7d lookback): ai_judgment 8 trades (1 adjacent buy→sell flip on IMB.L); rules 9 trades (1 IMB.L flip); momentum_grace 0 trades.
- Hold-buffer state: buffered_holdings = 0 on all tracks; reentry_cooldown active on IMB.L for ai_judgment and rules.
- Mark thickness: ai_judgment has 15 lifetime equity_marks (enough_history: true) but a new knob epoch started 2026-08-21 with 0 epoch marks — “Insufficient epoch marks for benchmark span.” rules has 16 lifetime / 7 epoch marks; momentum_grace 12 / 7. Lifetime marks support cross-track comparison; post-apply epoch marks are not yet thick enough to trust the min_conviction 0.45 change. Do not auto-apply further decision-review knob proposals (calibration priors are observe-only; readiness.ready_for_priors = false for both calibrated tracks).
sections.signal_backtest_findings:
- Archived backtest (run_count 10, 7-day horizon only in top_horizons): buy +2.19% excess (381 obs), hold +1.45% (1,125), strong_buy +1.06% (144), avoid +0.88% (335), insufficient_data −0.22% (4). Signal monotonicity holds at 7d (buy > hold > strong_buy > avoid).
- Historical analysis (run_count 10, window 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-23, ~3 observation_weeks): overlay:buy smoothed excess +2.61% at 7d (350 obs); overlay:hold +1.71% (1,188). Overlay vs screen at 7d: smoothed_overlay_excess +2.20% vs smoothed_screen_excess +2.13% (sample_count 525, downgrade_count 0) — modest overlay uplift in archive, not in offline sim.
- Offline simulation (10 periods each): research_overlay −10.58% excess (46 trades, £142.30 costs); static_levels −0.11% (1 trade); trailing_levels −0.11% (1 trade); momentum_grace −0.05% (22 trades, £31.35 costs). Comparison note: “Research overlay produced identical returns to screen-only over this window.”
- Forward paper evidence (separate from archive): ai_judgment counterfactual replay (9/9 log entries, Jul 25–Aug 21) shows simulated_return −9.92% vs actual −15.62% over the same window — proposed knobs would have reduced cost_drag by ~10.9 pp but still negative.
- run_count ≥ 2 on backtest, historical, and simulation — history is seeded; technical paper track (2 lifetime marks, enough_history: false) is still seeding.
sections.paper_track_comparison:
- ai_judgment (primary): −17.68% excess, 21.25% cost drag, 3 positions, min_conviction applied 0.40→0.45 on 2026-08-21 for “High cost drag (21.2%).” Last run: 3 trades. Calibrated shadow (ai_judgment_calibrated): −5.67% excess, 4.82% cost drag, 6 trades — materially better than live primary on both return and costs, but knobs frozen (decision-review apply skipped).
- rules (control): −26.84% excess, 29.0% cost drag, 48 lifetime trades — worst absolute performer; no knob changes applied. Higher churn (9 trades/7d) and 1 IMB.L adjacent flip mirror primary churn pattern.
- momentum_grace (experimental): −1.78% excess, 2.91% cost drag, 5 positions, 0 trades in last 7d — best paper track on both excess and cost efficiency; no knob changes. Not included in knob_calibration_priors (only rules and ai_judgment calibrated).
- knob_calibration_priors (observe_only: true, human gate required; ready_for_priors: false, acted_entries 9 ai_judgment / 7 rules vs floor 8):
  - ai_judgment recommended_prior: max_positions 5, min_conviction 0.0, confidence “low”; changed_vs_current: {max_positions: 5, min_conviction: 0.0}; fitness_delta_vs_current +0.0099; cohort_hit_rate 17.5%, cohort_fitness −0.1528; shadow_track_id ai_judgment_calibrated.
  - rules recommended_prior: same knob set (max_positions 5, min_conviction 0.0), confidence “low”; changed_vs_current: {max_positions: 5, min_conviction: 0.0}; fitness_delta_vs_current +0.0523; full_period_score +0.2667 vs ai_judgment −0.023.
  - Retrospective priors point toward wider book and lower conviction floor — opposite direction to the live-applied min_conviction raise; treat as competing shadow hypothesis only.
- exit_shadow: ai_judgment and rules each have 11 open / 0 closed exits; momentum_grace 0 open / 0 closed. Note: “Only 0 closed exit(s) so far; wait for a thicker cohort.” Grace-vs-rotation breakdown empty. Not yet actionable for momentum-grace tuning.
- Unrealized/realized PnL fields are not present in the payload.
sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [paper_churn] IMB.L adjacent buy→sell flip audit across ai_judgment and rules — quantify whether exit_confirm_screens=2 and reentry_cooldown=1 prevented a deeper loss or added round-trip cost; expected learning value: isolate whether conviction-driven exits or screen-rotation logic drove the flip and whether churn guards need tightening vs the min_conviction raise.

2. [paper_knobs] Seed ai_judgment_calibrated shadow with calibration prior {max_positions: 5, min_conviction: 0.0, sector_cap: 0.2} and run forward alongside live primary (min_conviction 0.45) — expected learning value: head-to-head endurance test of retrospective vs applied knob direction; human gate required before any config.json seeding (readiness.ready_for_shadow_bootstrap: false today).

3. [offline_sim] Archive-lab full-period rebalance replay for pre-logging history (counterfactual limitations cite “pre-logging history needs archive lab L111”) — expected learning value: reconcile archived 7d signal excess (+2.2%) with paper −17% excess by simulating full P&L path including costs, not just rebalance-log window.

4. [paper_churn] Exit-shadow closed-cohort accumulation sprint — hold exit_shadow knobs frozen until closed_count ≥ 10 on ai_judgment/rules, then score grace_vs_rotation post-exit paths — expected learning value: first evidence on whether momentum_grace would have retained winners vs screen-rotation exits (currently 0 closed across all tracks).

5. [monitoring] Epoch-zero dashboard for min_conviction 0.45 apply (started 2026-08-21) — track epoch equity_marks, epoch cost_drag, and epoch excess_after_costs separately from lifetime 15-mark history — expected learning value: determine within 2–3 marks whether the applied raise reduced trade_count/cost_drag without sacrificing the +9.16 pp control spread.
